title: Proof of mass tower coefficient stratification
html:
Proof. Proof of mass tower coefficient stratification

Proof. By the spectral-sequence collapse (spectral-sequence collapse) and its confinement reading (confinement = collapse), every observable on A factors through the centre Z(A) = \bigoplus_\lambda R \cdot e_\lambda. By the Wedderburn-enumeration completeness (enumeration), every \lambda \vdash n enters exactly one stratum. The unified mass formula (unified mass formula) identifies each historical Bethe--Weizsäcker term with its k-stratum, and Plancherel boundedness (Plancherel boundedness) guarantees the sum is convergent. \square

Computational handles.

The stratum-weight tables for n \in \{3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 12\} are generated by the formal derivation and serialised to computations/wedderburn-strata-witness.json. For each partition \lambda the witness records:

  • \dim V_\lambda (classical Hecke irrep dim, integer)
  • \dim_q V_\lambda at q_0 = 1.109978595642739\ldots (50 dps, categorical q-dim)
  • \mathrm{depth}(\lambda), \mathrm{height}(\lambda)
  • \mathrm{signed\_content}(\lambda) = \sum_{(i, j) \in \lambda} (j - i) (chirality marker; = 0 marks chirality cells)
  • Plancherel weight w_\lambda(1) = (\dim V_\lambda)^2 / n!
  • q-deformed alternative w_\lambda(q) = \dim_q^2 V_\lambda / [n]_q! (does not sum to 1 at finite q \neq 1 — Plancherel remark)

Note on the {}^4\mathrm{He} gap.

Whether the spectral-derived coefficients close the {}^4\mathrm{He} binding-energy gap is still under independent numerical verification. This proposition supplies the forcing structure: each Bethe--Weizsäcker coefficient is a specific Plancherel-weighted projection. Combined with (Plancherel boundedness) the fitting interpretation is replaced by structural derivation.
